proposed_features.name: hotel_competitive_density
proposed_features.description: Count of hotel/hospitality places within the same hex8 area indicating local competitive pressure
proposed_features.rationale: Competitive hotel density directly impacts occupancy rates and pricing power; requires room count data not just place counts

proposed_features.name: dist_changi_airport_km
proposed_features.description: Euclidean distance from hotel location to Changi Airport in kilometers
proposed_features.rationale: Airport proximity is critical for business travelers and transit tourists affecting occupancy patterns

proposed_features.name: dist_marina_bay_km
proposed_features.description: Euclidean distance from hotel location to Marina Bay CBD center in kilometers
proposed_features.rationale: CBD proximity drives corporate demand and premium pricing for business hotels

proposed_features.name: is_orchard_belt
proposed_features.description: Boolean indicating if hotel is within Orchard Road shopping belt area
proposed_features.rationale: Orchard Road hotels command premium rates due to shopping tourism and retail accessibility

proposed_features.name: is_sentosa_area
proposed_features.description: Boolean indicating if hotel is located in or near Sentosa resort island
proposed_features.rationale: Sentosa hotels have distinct leisure-driven demand patterns and seasonal pricing dynamics

proposed_features.name: review_volume_indicator
proposed_features.description: Log-transformed review count as proxy for hotel popularity and booking volume
proposed_features.rationale: Review volume correlates with booking frequency and can indicate demand levels for pricing

proposed_features.name: event_calendar_impact
proposed_features.description: Daily event intensity score from F1 GP, MICE events, and major conventions
proposed_features.rationale: Major events like F1 GP and MICE conventions cause demand spikes requiring dynamic pricing adjustments

proposed_features.name: daily_weather_rainfall_mm
proposed_features.description: Daily rainfall amount in millimeters affecting tourist outdoor activities
proposed_features.rationale: Monsoon rainfall impacts tourist behavior and can affect occupancy especially for leisure-focused hotels

proposed_features.name: is_branded_hotel
proposed_features.description: Boolean indicating if hotel belongs to a recognized international brand chain
proposed_features.rationale: Branded hotels have different pricing power and occupancy patterns versus independent properties

proposed_features.name: rating_premium_score
proposed_features.description: Normalized rating score indicating quality tier for pricing differentiation
proposed_features.rationale: Higher-rated hotels can command premium rates; normalized score enables pricing tier segmentation
